title: Modelling suicide ideation from beep to beep: Application of network analysis to ecological momentary assessment data
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-person network
limitations: - Sample only consists of inpatients with Major Depression; - Limited time window between assessments (30-120 min); - Self-report measures only; - Important risk factors (e.g., defeat, entrapment) not included; - May be underpowered to detect subtle dynamic relations
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered. Code and data availability are declared in the paper, but no specific repository or link is provided. The authors suggest future research should replicate findings with outpatient samples and different sampling strategies.
